SHIPPING_POLICY:
Shipping Policy

Free shipping to the United States. Every order shipped to a US address ships free — no minimum.

Processing time

Orders are processed within 1–3 business days (Monday–Friday, excluding holidays). You'll receive a confirmation email with tracking as soon as your order ships.

Delivery time

Once shipped, delivery usually takes 7–15 business days. Delivery times are estimates and may vary due to carrier delays, holidays or customs.

Other countries

We also ship to selected countries. Shipping rates and options are shown at checkout.

Tracking

Use the tracking link in your shipping confirmation email. If your tracking hasn't updated in 7 days, contact us at hachibiii.kyubiii53@gmail.com.

Wrong address or lost packages

Please double-check your address at checkout. If a package is lost in transit, contact us and we'll help you with a replacement or refund.
REFUND_POLICY:
Refund Policy — 30-Night Comfort Guarantee

We want you to sleep better. If you're not happy with your purchase, contact us within 30 days of delivery and we'll make it right.

How it works

  1. Email us at hachibiii.kyubiii53@gmail.com with your order number and a short note about the issue.
  2. We'll offer a replacement or a refund. In some cases we may ask you to return the item — if so, we'll send you instructions.
  3. Approved refunds are issued to your original payment method within 5–10 business days.

Damaged or defective items

If your item arrives damaged or defective, contact us within 30 days of delivery with a photo and we'll send a replacement or issue a full refund at no cost to you.

Exceptions

Shipping costs (if any were paid) are non-refundable unless the item was damaged, defective or incorrect. Items purchased on final sale can't be refunded.

Cancellations

You can cancel your order before it ships by contacting us. Once shipped, it's handled under this refund policy.

Customers in the EU also keep their statutory 14-day right of withdrawal.
PRIVACY_POLICY:
Privacy Policy

This Privacy Policy explains how Hushwell ("we", "us") collects, uses and protects your personal information when you visit or buy from our store.

Information we collect

  • Order information: name, email, shipping and billing address, phone number and order details.
  • Payment information: payments are processed securely by our payment providers; we don't store full card details.
  • Device and usage information: IP address, browser type and pages visited, collected through cookies and similar technologies.

How we use it

  • To process and deliver your orders and send order updates.
  • To provide customer support.
  • To prevent fraud and keep our store secure.
  • To improve our store and, only with your consent, to send marketing emails.

Sharing

We share information only with service providers that help us run the store — such as Shopify (our e-commerce platform), payment processors, and shipping and fulfillment partners — and when required by law. We don't sell your personal information.

Cookies

We use cookies to keep your cart working, remember preferences and understand how the store is used. You can manage cookies in your browser settings.

Your rights

Depending on where you live (including the EU/EEA and California), you may have the right to access, correct, delete or port your personal information, and to object to or restrict certain processing. To exercise these rights, email hachibiii.kyubiii53@gmail.com.

Retention

We keep order information as long as needed to fulfill orders and meet legal, tax and accounting obligations.

Contact

Questions? Contact us at hachibiii.kyubiii53@gmail.com. Hushwell, Valencia, Spain.
